incidents.name: VISTA flash-loan burn ignores frozen balances
incidents.notes: VISTA's flash-loan path burns the borrowed tokens on repayment without checking whether the balance it burns is frozen, letting the attacker convert frozen presale allocations into free supply and sell it.
